name: Money Money
look: A film still of Jim Carrey as the Mask, with a bright green face, yellow hat and yellow zoot suit, grinning wildly with his mouth open as he fans out two big handfuls of cash in a crowded nightclub with neon palm-tree lights.
use: Shows gleeful excitement about having money. Captions cover payday, a refund, a surprise bonus or finding cash in an old coat, usually as someone flaunting what feels like a fortune.
describe: the mask holding two fans of cash
green face guy in a yellow suit showing off money
jim carrey mask waving stacks of dollar bills

origin: Jim Carrey as the Mask flashing handfuls of cash in the 1994 comedy The Mask.
